description: This Java class implements a step in the loan lifecycle related to capitalized income amortization in a loan management system. It integrates with a processing service and is part of the loan cob (consolidated business) process.

classes.name: CapitalizedIncomeAmortizationBusinessStep
classes.description: A Spring component that performs a loan business step related to capitalized income amortization, utilizing a loan processing service and implementing the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the capitalized income amortization process on the given loan for the current business date.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the step name as an enum-styled string.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for this business step.
